item.title: Warm Lo-Fi Music Bed

turns.text: Make me a 10-second lo-fi hip-hop music bed, warm and relaxed. No vocals.

item.tests: Checks whether the delivered music matches the stated mood, genre and duration without unnecessary clarification.

answer_sheet.Vocals or language: Instrumental only; no vocals or spoken words.

must_haves: One playable music audio file is delivered.
The audio lasts 10 seconds, within 0.1 second.
The music has a recognizable laid-back hip-hop beat and mellow lo-fi texture.
The overall mood is warm and relaxed rather than tense or high-energy.
No singing or spoken words are audible.
